stories.headline: Thieves stole Nvidia trucks and found 40,000 pounds of sand
SpaceX sent Starship to orbit with all 33 engines firing
Claude Sonnet 5.5 is live right now
Anthropic lost 42 billion dollars last year betting on AI
OpenAI cancelled GPT-6.1 Astra over safety concerns
AI needs 755 percent more power by 2029 than it uses today
NVIDIA put out a free platform to control what AI agents can do

caption:
Here's what happened in AI in the last 24 hours, from crooks stealing Nvidia trucks full of sand to Starship flying to orbit with all 33 Raptor engines firing

Two thieves stole Nvidia-branded trailers expecting AI chips. They got 40,000 pounds of sand instead.

SpaceX launched Starship with all 33 Raptor engines firing at once, the first time that has happened on an orbital flight.

Claude Sonnet 5.5 is live now.

Anthropic lost $42B in 2025. They plan to spend $518B on cloud and infrastructure next year, per WSJ, betting AI changes the world more than electricity and the internet did.

OpenAI pulled GPT-6.1 Astra before launch over safety concerns.

US data centers will need 755% more power by 2029. Only 21 gigawatts are being built right now. That's a 57-gigawatt gap.

NVIDIA has a new free tool that limits what AI agents can touch on your system, useful if you're building with agents.

New models dropping, old ones getting pulled, power grids under strain, and thieves robbing Nvidia trucks. AI is mainstream enough now that the criminals have noticed. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: SpaceX, Anthropic, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Reuters, The Wall Street Journal
